speaker: Penny
text: Always nice chatting with you, Sheldon. Finley Vale contempt.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Sarcasm? Remember seven o'clock. Specific daylight time. Please reserve that butch spirit for the lanes.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I thought you were bringing your own bowling shoes. It's not my own bowling shoes. What's with the disinfectant? I know where my feet have been.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Hey, Penny. And you guys. Albino Bob couldn't make it, so I brought a substitute. I believe some of you know Will Wheaton.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Hi, Sheldon. How's it going? Well, well, well, if it isn't Will Wheaton. The Green Goblin to my Spider-Man. The Pocahontas to my Galileo. The Internet Explorer to my Firefox.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You're not still carrying a grudge because I beat you at that card tournament, are you? I'm the proud owner of willwheatonstinks.com.net and .org. What does that tell you? It tells me that I am living rent-free right here.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You ready to bowl? Oh, I'm ready. I don't know if Stuart told you what you're up against tonight, but before you stands the co-captain of the East Texas Christian Youth Holy Roller Bowling League Championship team.

text: Seven to twelve-year-old division. Also, Penny's pretty good.
